justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDateParser.java. PatternStrategy is a small abstract helper with one field (`Pattern pattern`) and only four methods: two `createPattern` overloads, `isNumber()`, `parse()`, an abstract `setCalendar()`, plus `toString()`. The file shows its responsibilities are shared by three concrete subclasses (`CaseInsensitiveTextStrategy`, `ISO8601TimeZoneStrategy`, `TimeZoneStrategy`), while the subclass-specific parsing and calendar-setting logic lives there, so PatternStrategy itself is not excessively large or multi-responsibility.
